name: OpenVibe.Services
description: OpenVibe.Services is the way into everything programmable on OpenVibe: projects, apps, keys, grants and usage over Network's developer API; generated API, contract, SDK, capability and event docs; OAuth and webhook tools; playgrounds; app and mod releases; and one resource index over every service, with each service keeping its own data.

pillars.title: Discover
pillars.text: Every service, capability, contract and event, with generated API references.

pillars.title: Build
pillars.text: Projects, apps, keys, grants, playgrounds, OAuth and webhook tools, starter code.

pillars.title: Ship
pillars.text: App and mod manifests, releases and trust tiers, with a public page per app.

pillars.title: Operate
pillars.text: Usage, quotas, exports and one resource index over the whole network.

faq.question: What is OpenVibe.Services for?
faq.answer: Building on the network: make a project, register apps, create keys and grants, watch usage, and read generated docs for every API, contract, SDK, capability and event.

faq.question: Can I publish an app or a mod?
faq.answer: Yes. App and mod manifests are released here with a trust tier, and each app gets a public page.

faq.question: Where does my data live?
faq.answer: Each OpenVibe service keeps its own data. Services shows one resource index over all of them, with usage, quotas and exports.

keywords: openvibe services, developer platform, open source backend, api platform, event bus api, ai gateway, website monitoring api, developer console
